hyperedges.label: Backend agent guidance stack (agent + skill + CLAUDE.md)
Testable layered architecture via DI and fakes

nodes.label: TDD with Vitest/Supertest
nodes.rationale: Write a failing test, make it pass, then refactor; keeps code testable.

nodes.label: Report-back API contract
nodes.rationale: Final API contract (method, path, JSON, status codes) is reported so the client can mirror it.

nodes.label: Repository interface + Prisma implementation
nodes.rationale: Domain-shaped interface lets services be tested with in-memory fakes instead of Prisma mocks.

nodes.label: In-memory fake repository
nodes.rationale: Unit-test services with Map-backed fakes; tests never touch a real DB or network.

nodes.label: Error body and status code conventions
nodes.norm_label: error body and status code conventions

nodes.label: loadEnv() single config source
nodes.rationale: Never read process.env elsewhere; config is zod-validated in one place.

nodes.label: Prisma db push (no migrate for MongoDB)
nodes.rationale: prisma migrate is unsupported for MongoDB, so schema is synced with db push.
nodes.norm_label: prisma db push (no migrate for mongodb)

nodes.label: Prisma 6.19 version pin
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 has no MongoDB connector and Prisma 8 (Mongo-native) is only an RC; do not upgrade without verifying MongoDB support.

nodes.label: routes -> service -> repository flow
nodes.rationale: Routes hold no business logic; services never import Express or Prisma, keeping layers testable.

nodes.label: createApp / AppDependencies injection
nodes.rationale: createApp(deps) does no I/O so tests can pass fakes; server.ts is the composition root.

nodes.label: AppError subclasses + error handler
nodes.rationale: Express 5 forwards async errors automatically, so no try/catch in routes.

nodes.label: Malformed ObjectId treated as not found
nodes.norm_label: malformed objectid treated as not found

nodes.label: mongo service (mongo:8, replica set rs0)
nodes.rationale: Prisma needs MongoDB running as a replica set even for local development; healthcheck auto-initiates rs0.
